description.value: Strawberry Flats Campground is a 15-site BC Parks site within Muncho Lake Provincial Park along the Alaska Highway in far Northern BC, offering access to the park's celebrated turquoise lake and mountain scenery; it operates seasonally with the gate locked and no services off-season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies Strawberry Flats Campground as a fee-based, 15-site camp_site operated by Kootenay Forest Services Ltd. within Muncho Lake Provincial Park. The BC Parks website confirms the campground exists, is vehicle-accessible from the Alaska Highway at km 681, and states 'most of the frontcountry campsites at Muncho Lake Park are offered on a first come, first served basis' while also noting 'You can now book some s...' (text truncated), indicating partial reservations are available. No amenity details (water, toilets, showers, etc.) appear in the fetched content, so those fields remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: OSM operator is 'Kootenay Forest Services Ltd.' with a Gmail contact address, while the listed website is the official BC Parks government page — the campground may be privately operated under a service agreement with BC Parks, which could create contact ambiguity.
Phone number (+1-250-776-7000) is attributed to the private operator in OSM and could not be verified against the website content.
The OSM website URL points to the parent Muncho Lake Park page rather than a campground-specific page; no dedicated Strawberry Flats URL is available.
Website subpages for contact, reservations, and find-a-park all returned 404, limiting detail available from the fetched content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational BC Parks frontcountry campground with confirmed presence on the Alaska Highway; directly relevant to touring cyclists passing through northern BC.
enrichment_extras.notes: Capacity of 15 sites per OSM tags. Internet access confirmed absent per OSM (internet_access=no). The fetched BC Parks page was partially truncated, cutting off the reservations booking description.
